description: Source code for MPU testing commands in Zephyr RTOS, including memory read/write, flash write, and code execution in RAM.

methods.name: cmd_read
methods.description: Reads a value from a reserved memory address and prints it.

methods.name: cmd_write_mcux
methods.description: Writes a value to flash memory for MCUX platforms.

methods.name: cmd_write_stm32
methods.description: Writes a value to flash memory for STM32 platforms.

methods.name: cmd_write
methods.description: Writes a value to a specific memory address for other platforms.

methods.name: cmd_mtest
methods.description: Performs a memory test by reading or writing to a specified address.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Initializes flash device and sets up MPU commands.
